title_zh: 黄山:云海中的奇松怪石
title_en: Beautiful Places in China (6/20): Huangshan, Strange Pines and Rocks in a Sea of Clouds
note_en: 越…越… expresses "the more..., the more...": 爬得越高，云海就越壮观 "The higher you climb, the more spectacular the sea of clouds." Each half is 越 plus a verb or adjective, and 就 often links them, as again at the end: 爬得越高，看到的风景就越让人难忘. Notice that Chinese needs no word for "the," and the adjective 壮观 simply follows 越 without any "more."
